narr: After a brief break, another push of monsoon moisture fueled another round of thunderstorms over the Mojave Desert. Some storms produced flash flooding.
ev: Pump Station Road was closed from Highway 93 to Back Road due to flooding.
Water and debris flowed over Stockton Hill Road.
Antares Road was closed after flooding carved a foot deep rut into the road.
lsr: MOHAVE COUNTY OFFICIALS CLOSED PUMP STATION ROAD FROM BACK ROAD TO US 93 ON JULY 29TH AT 1640 DUE TO FLOODING. ESTIMATED TIME FLOODING BEGAN AT 1630.
WATER FLOWING ACROSS STOCKTON HILL ROAD.
COUNTY OFFICIALS CLOSED ANTARES ROAD FROM PIERCE FERRY ROAD TO HUNTINGTON AVENUE DUE TO FLASH FLOODING DAMAGE. A FOOT DEEP RUT HAS BEEN CARVED INTO THE ROAD DUE TO FLOOD WATERS. TIME AND LOCATION EST
